page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic, & Amaf.

main_text.p: venio ad annum usque M. cccc. lxxxi. Eppone moriuo,re-liquaPræ-fectura veteris ci-vitati Groning. accesfere. Interim Eppone quoque rebus humanis anno M.cccc. xli i i, aut M. cccc. xliiii. exempto[?], qui in parte juris priftini, quod habere fe à majoribus exiftimabat, in Præfectura vetere remanserat, Groningani confensu populi, & pacto quodam cum Eppone freti, arcem ejus Brocaeam, dejecto præsidio, & vidua Epponis Frouwa Ulrici Grethani sorore, occuparunt, universumque imperium prætorium secundùm Dullarti oram in se verterunt, salvo reliquo jure, libertate αὐτο-νομία populi. Datusque à senatu præfectus, qui diceret jus, à quo provocatio ad senatum & civitatem esset. In eaque conditione libens tota illa ora ad Dullarum sine mutatione ulla perstitit usque ad tempora Saxonica, seque à Rep. & societate reliquarum agri hujus partium sejunxit, nec exportandi importandi-ve lege, nec cæteris istarum pactis cum civitate obligata ab eo tempore fuit. Hoc exemplo vicini Westerwoldii commoti, cum longius tendere, quàm à majoribus relictum acceperat, usurpare Eggo

page.notes: Marginal note text is printed in small italic type at the left margin; the hyphenated words are kept as printed. "exempto" and "xli i i" are doubtful readings. The Greek word is split across the line end at "αὐτο-" / "νομία". "Westerwoldii" is read from a worn word and may be "Wefterwoldii" in print. Show-through and the digitiser mark at the lower right are left out.
